channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: Historic Grade II listed Hamble home with river views goes on market for £1.5m
item.description: An historic village home with sweeping river views has gone on the market for £1.5 million in Hamble-le-Rice.

item.title: War in Iran causing 'worry, sadness and anger' for Southampton residents
item.description: Community leaders and politicians in Hampshire have voiced concern over the escalating situation in Iran.

item.title: Builder who allegedly failed to finish work denies fraud charges
item.description: A man has appeared in court to deny fraud by not completing construction work in and producing fake documents in Southampton, Hedge End and Fareham

item.title: Work has started on housing scheme to see 375 new homes built on farmland
item.description: Developers behind a major housing scheme in Botley have applied to formally confirm that work has already begun on a project that will deliver up to 375 homes.

item.title: Inside the Southampton brew pub with beer matched food and quirky beach huts
item.description: Brewhouse and Kitchen is the Southampton brew pub serving more than 70 craft beers and ciders with a beer matched food menu and quirky beach huts.

item.title: New grandparents win £400,000 on lottery - this is what they will do with cash
item.description: A grandmother from Gosport who scooped £400,000 in People's Postcode Lottery win says she still wouldn't splash out £1,000 on a handbag.

item.title: Landlords stop renting homes as no-fault evictions set to be banned
item.description: No-fault evictions look to be on the rise in Southampton as landlords stop renting homes ahead of major changes to the private rented sector, a council meeting was told

item.title: Couple who died in the New Forest named as inquest opens into deaths
item.description: An inquest has opened into the death of a couple from Kent who were found dead in the New Forest.

item.title: Inside legendary club which drew customers from all over the region
item.description: To a generation of Hampshire clubbers, Eastleigh’s Martines was not just a nightclub, it was the unrivalled home of weekend nightlife.

item.title: Company sues Saints for £3.2million in dispute over termination of contract
item.description: Southampton FC are fighting a £3.2million legal case lodged by a catering company that claims it is owed cash after its contract was terminated early.
